author: TwistedTea
quote: I don’t even know where to begin with this game. It is easily one of the most boring games I have ever played, and coming from someone who actually liked Red Dead Redemption 2’s opening, that says a lot. Pretty graphics do not make a good game, especially when the frame rate is capped at 30 fps and still drops constantly during gameplay. Instead of actually doing anything fun, I found myself stuck running mundane errands and chores for Lucia and everyone else. Jason’s VA has to be one of the worst things about this game, right next to how annoying Lucia is. The controls are terrible too. Having to hold down a trigger everywhere just to press another button to interact with people or objects feels completely tedious. Not being able to play like a real GTA and cause spontaneous chaos without getting punished kills the whole point of the franchise. On top of that, the hotel scene was awful. It wasn't shocking at all, just gross. I have never had a game make me shut it off and lose the desire to play anything else because it turned gaming into slow, tedious work.
